name: 80525 · Fort Collins, CO
findings: ZIP 80525 (Fort Collins) has 246 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80525 (Fort Collins) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 youth organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
